teamDescription: We worked together on the API, infrastructure and admin panel.
spiderfinanceFeatureAccounts: Keep accounts, categories and transactions in one place, including transfers, filters and balance reconciliation.
spiderfinanceFeaturePlanning: Plan income, regular bills, one-off payments and debt instalments.
spiderfinanceFeatureForecasts: See your balance and available money day by day, across pay cycles.
spiderfinanceFeatureSavings: Set savings goals, earmark money and track budgets with statistics.
spiderfinanceFeatureInvestments: Record investments with manual valuations and view your net worth by currency.
spiderfinanceFeatureImportExport: Import CSV and XLSX, export JSON, CSV or XLSX, and try scenarios without changing real transactions.
spiderfinanceContribution: My commits include work on savings and reports, plus email features such as SMTP, verification, invitations, password recovery and actions from emails.
spiderfinanceSummary: Track accounts, budgets and savings, and see how much money you’re likely to have available.
spiderfinanceDescription: SpiderFinance brings accounts, transactions, budgets and savings goals together in an app you can host yourself. You can plan income, expenses and debts, see how much money you’ll have between paychecks and compare scenarios without changing real transactions. The frontend uses React and the API uses FastAPI. Behind the scenes, the backend is a modular monolith with ports and adapters; it runs in Docker.
cliponomiconApiSummary: Upload and share video clips. The API processes files in the background and controls who can watch them.
cliponomiconApiDescription: Cliponomicon API lets you upload, organize and share video clips. You can play and download them, save favorites and leave reactions. Redis, RQ and FFmpeg create video versions and thumbnails in the background. There’s also JWT or OpenID Connect login and a React admin panel for users, videos and worker tasks. The code is split into modules so the business rules, API and infrastructure are kept clear.
cliponomiconApiFeatureUpload: Upload videos, add categories and tags, and choose whether they’re public or limited to signed-in users.
cliponomiconApiFeatureProcessing: Create H.264 versions and thumbnails in the background; see errors and retry jobs from the admin panel.
cliponomiconApiFeaturePlayback: Play and download videos, save favorites and add reactions.
cliponomiconApiFeatureAuth: Sign in with JWT or OpenID Connect, with access based on roles and video ownership.
cliponomiconApiFeatureSteam: Look up games from public Steam profiles and import categories and artwork from SteamGridDB.
cliponomiconApiFeatureBackoffice: Use the admin panel to manage users and videos, check the job queue and see the activity log.
cliponomiconApiContribution: My commits cover recovering pending jobs when the worker starts, confirming retries, sorting the video list and handling file dates.
cliponomiconApiQuote: Upload your clips; the API handles processing and access.
spiderportfolioSummary: Build portfolio pages with a visual editor, save drafts and publish them when they’re ready.
spiderportfolioDescription: SpiderPortfolio lets you build portfolio pages with a visual editor and reusable components. You can save drafts, preview changes and publish them later.
spidertomp3Status: In development · Version 0.3.0 is not released yet
spidertomp3Summary: Download and convert audio, organize playlists and podcasts, and pick up where you left off.
spidertomp3Description: SpiderToMP3 downloads audio from links supported by yt-dlp and converts it with FFmpeg. You can preview a playlist before downloading, pick the track order and cancel or retry jobs in the queue. It also imports RSS podcasts and playlists, and can look up metadata on MusicBrainz. It’s built with Python and PySide6 and distributed for Windows and Linux.
spidertomp3FeatureFormats: Download audio from links supported by yt-dlp and convert it to MP3, M4A, Opus, FLAC or WAV.
spidertomp3FeaturePlaylists: Preview playlists and choose which tracks to download and in what order.
spidertomp3FeatureQueue: Save the queue, see progress for each track, and cancel, resume or retry downloads.
spidertomp3FeatureLists: Catch duplicates and import or export playlists in CSV, M3U and M3U8.
spidertomp3FeaturePodcasts: Import RSS podcasts and add tags and artwork if you want; you can also look up details on MusicBrainz.
spidertomp3FeatureUpdates: Check executable updates with SHA-256, adjust history settings and choose a light, dark or high-contrast theme.
spidertomp3Contribution: My commits include changes to the interface and queue, retries, clipboard input and drag-and-drop. They also cover privacy, tests, updates and distributing the executables.
spidertomp3ScopeNote: These features are in the current code, but some haven’t made it into a published release yet. Supported sources depend on yt-dlp; Spotify isn’t supported. The 0.3.0 executables still need testing on clean installations before release.
spidertomp3Quote: Download audio and pick up your queue whenever you like.
spiderawakeSummary: An Android alarm that asks you to complete challenges before turning it off.
spiderawakeDescription: SpiderAwake is an Android alarm built with Python, Kivy and Java. It uses challenges and mini-games to wake you up. Reliability on Android devices is still being checked.
rehuseSummary: Organize patients, exercises and rehabilitation routines through an API.
rehuseDescription: ReHuse is a backend for managing patients, exercises and physiotherapy routines. It also generates PDF documents.
projectRehuse: An API for organizing patients, exercises and rehabilitation routines.
